title: StreamDrop
subtitle: YouTube Downloader for Android
description: A high-performance, on-device Android application for downloading YouTube videos and audio. Engineered with a modern MVVM architecture using Jetpack Compose, it leverages yt-dlp and FFmpeg to process media securely without external servers. Features include intelligent background downloading via WorkManager, direct MP3 extraction, and a dynamic Material 3 interface.

title: AI Talkie (VoiceAI)
subtitle: Continuous-Conversation Voice Assistant
description: An always-listening, continuous-conversation AI voice assistant for Android inspired by TARS from Interstellar. Built natively with Kotlin, it integrates Android's SpeechRecognizer and TextToSpeech APIs with the Groq API (Llama 3) for near-instant, natural responses. Engineered with a lightweight OkHttp networking stack to ensure high performance on lower-end devices, featuring graceful error recovery and short-term conversation memory.
